text:
alex: Quick sketch — we need a compact checklist for the next round of benchmarks: kernel selection, batching heuristics, and KV-cache warmup behavior. Thoughts?

maria: +1. can we keep it deterministic so apples-to-apples comparisons are reliable?

chen: Agree. Biggest flake is KV-cache warmup. Two ideas: explicit warmup phase vs traffic-shaped prefill.

frank: Explicit warmup is easier to reason about for TTFT but may hide real-world cold starts.

alex: Right. Proposal: three-stage run — cold probe (no cache), controlled warmup (prefill using replay traces), steady-state replay (measured).

sara: Love that. We should capture TTFT (time-to-first-token) on cold probe and p95/p99 during steady-state. Also log TPOT if possible.

chen: Quick defs to keep everyone aligned:
- TTFT = time from request acceptance until first byte of model output.
- TPOT = time per output token after first token (wall time / tokens).
- Goodput = completed requests that meet quality/latency SLO per second (not raw QPS).

maria: Can we add a short script snippet to run the warmup? Something like: 

```bash
# prefill keys from replay file
cat replay.json | jq -c '.requests[]' | xargs -P8 -I{} ./client --prefill '{}' --no-collect
```

frank: Also include a tiny profiling snippet to capture kernel choice and time spent in matmul/attention: 

```text
PROFILE: kernel=flash_attention v2; matmul: 12.3ms; attention: 23.1ms; kv-lookup: 2.9ms
```

alex: For apples-to-apples kernel selection, we should fix model config (seq_len, batch sizing) and pin compile flags. Document these in the run artifact.

sara: On batching heuristics: benchmark both continuous-batching and static-window batching. Measure effect on TTFT and p95. Hypothesis: continuous reduces average TPOT but can slightly increase TTFT variance.

chen: We need a reproducible traffic shape generator for steady-state: percentile-based inter-arrival times + token-length distribution from replay. I'd like to keep replay harness for correctness and synth for corner cases.

maria: Can we add one table in the artifact with columns: run_id, kernel_variant, batching_mode, kv_warmup_strategy, TTFT_p50/p95/p99, TPOT_mean, goodput, attempts, notes

frank: +1. Also capture kernel selection logs: compile hash, kernel fallback events. sample log line: 

```text
KERNEL-LOG: run=2170123456 kernel=matmul_fused_v3 fallback=none seq=128 batch=8
```

alex: Regression procedure: if p95 or goodput worsen by >5% vs baseline, automatically mark run as suspect and capture full flamegraph + model traces.

loadbot: incident-check: run 2170123001 had kv-warmup misconfiguration. flagging similarity in config (prefill=0).

chen: Good call. We should store warmup artifacts (keys hit rate over time). Plot cumulativekv_hit_ratio(t). Expect reaching 90% hit within warmup window for stable runs.

sara: For metrics pipeline: send TTFT as separate series from TPOT so alerts can target cold-start spikes vs throughput regressions.

maria: One more: record per-kernel p95 (matmul_p95, attn_p95) to see micro-regressions that don't show in end-to-end p95 yet.

alex: I'll draft the checklist and a minimal runner tomorrow. High priority: make sure we can reproduce kernel selection deterministically (fix seeds, compiler env, and driver versions).

frank: Also capture GPU PCIe/CPU steal metrics during run. microcontention can skew TTFT.

chen: If anyone wants to prototype the prefiller code, ping me and I'll share the small replay-parsing lib.

sara: tagging @maria for the alert thresholds design.

maria: on it. I'll propose initial thresholds (TTFT_p95  > baseline*1.2 alert, goodput drop > 7% alert).

alex: Great. Action items:
- alex: write checklist + baseline artifact template
- chen: share replay parser + prefiller snippet
- maria: thresholds / alert config
- frank: flamegraph hooks and collection recipe
- sara: per-kernel metric list and dashboard layout

sara: I'll also add a short FAQ for why we run synth vs replay in the run artifact.

alex: Perfect. Closing loop: we'll run one smoke with the three-stage plan by EOD Friday. If configs look good we'll run full regression next week. :calendar: :rocket:

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:

frank: thanks!

loadbot: note: archived artifacts for this thread will be at /artifacts/2170123456 on completion.
